name: R3D (Wuhu R3D Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: Chinese filament manufacturer in Wuhu, Anhui, founded 2014 and running at roughly 1,800 kg/day. Sells direct-to-consumer through r3dprint.com and through European resellers, with a branded range - RevoPLA, RadiantPLA, RevoPETG, RevoFlex, RuggedMaster - covering commodity through flexible and styrenic grades at budget pricing.

product_lines.name: RevoPLA
product_lines.notes: Base and toughened PLA, the volume line.

product_lines.name: RadiantPLA (silk / matte / wood / colour-change)
product_lines.notes: Decorative PLA family spanning luster, matte, wood-filled and colour-changing finishes on a PLA base.

product_lines.name: RevoPETG (incl. GF and marble)
product_lines.notes: Standard PETG plus a glass-fibre grade; marble is a pigment effect on the base chemistry.

product_lines.name: RevoFlex TPU 90A / 95A and PEBA 90A
product_lines.notes: Two TPU shore grades plus a polyether block amide elastomer, which is a different chemistry from TPU.

additional_notes: Pricing around USD 18/kg. Output figure (~1,800 kg/day) is the company's own. Despite the D2C storefront, much of the volume reaches Europe through resellers such as Filament2Print.

provenance.conflicts: FALSE LEAD, recorded explicitly: Raise3D publishes a product URL containing the slug 'r3d-premium-petg'. That is Raise3D's own PETG and has nothing to do with Wuhu R3D Technology - the two companies are unrelated, and the slug must not be treated as evidence of a link or an OEM relationship. Separately, the ~1,800 kg/day capacity claim is self-reported.
